drawing_resolution.classification: Engineering reading of official dimension lines, not a separate written manufacturer FAQ.
drawing_resolution.supersedes_previous_field: current-axis-precision-selection/report.json preferred.drawing.under_head_detail_other_mark_max_mm=1 is a reading error; it must not be consumed.
drawing_resolution.head_shape_envelope: With b measured from the actual under-head bearing plane toward the shoulder end: all root material0<=b<=2.5 lies inside diameter8.7; beyond that region the specified Dg6 shoulder applies, until the other end transition.
drawing_resolution.no_support_inference: This maximum outer envelope gives collision clearance, not minimum solid diameter or full bearing support.

head_clearance_contract_example.condition: These are proposed actual-part acceptance windows, not FDM accuracy proven by nominal STL. Root-axis floating upward moves the transition away from the lowest relief boundary.

thread_end_findings.review_limit: Reviewed current family drawing plus listed official archives and narrowly targeted manufacturer searches. No claim that no unretrieved document exists.

proposed_tail_procurement_acceptance_con.scope: Complete interference/seat/engagement interface envelope for a quoted or inspected part; not a stress, fatigue or torque qualification.
proposed_tail_procurement_acceptance_con.datum: A is the tail-end shoulder bearing plane; s=0 at A, s>0 toward the M6 tip; all radial values reference the g6 shoulder axis.
proposed_tail_procurement_acceptance_con.shaft_material: SUS304/A2-50 retained as a request; if custom machining changes certified strength, require supplier certification rather than retaining the catalogue class by name.

shaft.thread_class_requested: 6g; verify with appropriate GO/NO-GO gauges; catalogue class not inferred.
shaft.burr_and_edge_condition: No burr, upset or edge break may violate the radial envelopes or the guaranteed shoulder annulus.

custom_metal_washer.material_request: A2 stainless; hardness/load suitability separately qualified

assembly_registration.required: A verified centering feature or independent bounded actual registration is required. The M6 through-bore alone does not guarantee0.05. No manual visual centering assumption is allowed.
assembly_registration.if_unmet: Recompute the root counterbore and remaining annulus with the true eccentricity, or design a positive metal registration. Do not treat the numerical example as closed.

nut.thread_request: M6x1 compatible internal thread, preferably explicitly6H; catalogue thread class is not inferred.
nut.nylon_locking_zone: Must lie inside the fully formed screw thread interval after washer seating.
nut.torque_and_reuse: Obtain declared locking torque, tightening procedure and reuse policy; no torque assigned here.

inspection_deliverables: Dimensioned profile or CMM/optical trace referenced toA and the g6 axis for both root regions.
Actual head dimensions and shoulder spacing; root envelopes may be inspected by a profile gauge.
Shoulder annulus and washer counterbore depth/diameter/face-error records.
Thread GO/NO-GO results and full-thread start/end positions.
Evidence of the total assembly registration bound; otherwise the pair remains unaccepted.
proposed_tail_procurement_acceptance_con.rejection_rule: Any unmet interface field rejects this specific pairing; source silence or a dimensionless supplier CAD model cannot count as acceptance.

alternative_note: No extra ready-made shoulder was asserted. Existing catalogue candidate plus a declared acceptance contract is the bounded output; manufacturer acceptance and the centering feature remain distinct requirements.
